title: fix(sdui-parser): validateTree no longer calls a declared bind unknown (objectui#11008)
body:
Fixes #11008
Clause-②: no

Seat `domain:ui#2`, PM session `session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`, branch `claude/issue-11008-bind-base-prop` (PM claim `5882983059`). Route 1 of the card, per triage direction `5874689995` and review addendum `5874136200`.

## What this changes

`validateTree` (`@object-ui/sdui-parser`) keeps a `BASE_PROPS` set of keys every node may carry without an `unknown-prop` warning. `BaseSchema` declares `bind` and `hidden` for every node, and no registration declares either as an input. So the undeclared-key branch answered every authored one with `unknown-prop` (`has no prop "bind"`), including on the nodes that honour it: `list`, `tree-view` and the `object-*` widgets read `bind` through `useDataScope`, and `SchemaRenderer`'s hide chain reads `hidden` for every node. Both keys now join `BASE_PROPS`.

- `packages/sdui-parser/src/validate.ts`: `'hidden'` and `'bind'` join `BASE_PROPS`. The docblock says why, names the accepted cost (`data-table` + `bind` is now silent at this tier), and says why `placeholder` stays out.
- `packages/types/src/base.ts`: the `BaseSchema.bind` docblock, in its objectui#10981 wording, drops the parser half. It names the render-time `[ObjectUI] DataTable bind:` console warning (objectui#6575) as the one signal and says the parser tier is silent.
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/silence-clause-parser-tier-closure-10981.test.ts`: `BIND_CLAUSE` is rewritten to that sentence. A negative assertion on the retired "`unknown-prop` warning both name it" wording is added, and the header's `bind` bullet records the move.
- New pin `packages/sdui-parser/src/__tests__/base-props-bind-hidden-11008.test.ts` (the tier's reading of a manifest):
  - both keys draw nothing in every value shape `BaseSchema` admits;
  - the near-miss `bindTo` / `hide` still draws one `unknown-prop` naming it;
  - a registration that declares `placeholder` keeps its `type-mismatch`.
- New pin `packages/components/src/renderers/__tests__/bind-base-prop-parser-tier-11008.test.tsx`, in the shape of `header-bar-unknown-prop-parser-tier-10981.test.tsx` (live registry):
  - no registration declares either key;
  - `list` / `tree-view` + `bind` or `hidden` draw nothing;
  - `data-table` + `bind` draws nothing;
  - the lit control, `bindTo` on `data-table`, draws `unknown-prop`;
  - across every live registration, neither key draws a diagnostic naming it.
- `.changeset/11008-bind-base-prop.md`: `patch` for `@object-ui/sdui-parser` and `@object-ui/types`, because the docblock ships in the emitted `.d.ts`.

Landing site as the claim declared it. No producer outside `sdui-parser` / `types` was involved.

## Bounded in-place fix: `hidden` (dispatch zone 2, item 2)

Both keys the addendum named were measured through `validateTree` before deciding:

- **`hidden` is included.** It drew `unknown-prop` on every registered type and is declared by none. That is the same defect class, fixed the same mechanical way in the same file, and checked by the same gate family. It is pinned beside `bind` in both new files.
- **`placeholder` is left out.** It draws `unknown-prop` on the types that do not declare it. But the input family (`input`, `textarea`, `select`, `combobox`, `date-picker`, `element:text_input`, …) declares it as a typed input, and `BASE_PROPS` membership skips the declared-input lookup. Adding it would silence those registrations' `type-mismatch`, so the fix is not the same. It is left as it was, and the sdui-parser pin holds the type check it would have silenced.

## Measurements

The probe was a temporary vitest file, deleted after use and never committed. It loaded `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/fields`, fourteen `plugin-*` packages and `plugin-tree` into the registry (488 known types at `b3c96d6bc`). It then built the manifest over every known key with `manifestFromConfigs` and ran `validateTree` once per key per type.

| key | types drawing `unknown-prop` before | after | registrations declaring it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bind` | 488 of 488 | 0 | 0 |
| `hidden` | 488 of 488 | 0 | 0 |
| `placeholder` | 470 | 470 | 18, each answering `placeholder: 424242` with `type-mismatch`, before and after |

`bind` on each reader the docblock names drew `has no prop "bind"` before this change. The readers are `list`, `tree-view`, `object-chart`, `object-data-table`, `object-pivot`, `object-grid`, `object-kanban`, `object-gallery` and `object-timeline`. After the change, each draws nothing beyond its own bindless control's diagnostics (`missing-required-prop` for `objectName` and the like). `data-table` + `bind` also drew `unknown-prop` before and draws nothing after.

## Tests and gates

The union ran after the final commit, at HEAD `2e74398a2`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/sdui-parser/ packages/types/`, plus three components pins (the two parser-tier pins and `skill-guide-data-table-binding.test.tsx`) and six `scripts/__tests__` changeset-state suites: **306 files, 6959 tests passed**.
- The parser's consumer radius is every other test file importing `@object-ui/sdui-parser` (apps/console, cli, components, layout, plugin-*, schema-catalog, scripts, vscode-extension): **46 files, 893 tests passed**.
- Gates at HEAD, each exit 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new), `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-no-major`. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the six paths answers NOT GOVERNED.

Earlier runs, on the tree whose only later change is the changeset text:

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/PKG type-check` for `sdui-parser`, `types` and `components` exits 0 after `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/components^...' build`. `tsc --listFilesOnly` confirms that each package's test project reads the new or edited test file.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the five changed code files: 0 errors. The 20 warnings are pre-existing `no-explicit-any` in `base.ts`, outside this diff's hunk.
- `check-changeset-claims`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-phantom-dependencies`, `check-package-self-import` and `check-shell-escape-residue` each exit 0.

Declared narrowing: the full `pnpm test`, the repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full type-check farm are CI's.

## Reverse verification (one-off; both legs committed first, and neither left behind a permanent test)

Both mutations used objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which wraps the command, checks the anchor count and blob change, and restores with `git checkout HEAD` plus a blob comparison.

1. **Deleting `'hidden',` and `'bind',` from `BASE_PROPS`.** Anchor 1 → 0, blob `0f8971827c72` → `43ca588eb800`.
   - Result: **6 failed, 6 passed (12)**. Every fix row went red: the `bind` / `hidden` value-shape rows, `list`, `tree-view`, `data-table`, and the all-registrations row.
   - The controls stayed green: the bare node, `bindTo` / `hide`, the `placeholder` type check, the "no registration declares either key" row, and `bindTo` on `data-table`.
   - Restored: blob equals HEAD `0f8971827c72`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
   - A first attempt in replace mode was refused by the tool, because the replacement was a substring of the anchor (count 1 → 1). It was restored at once, so it was a no-op, not a measurement.
2. **Planting the retired "`unknown-prop` warning both name it" wording back into the `bind` docblock.** Blob `b55fd9e624f4` → `90beeaf14308`.
   - Result: **1 failed, 8 passed (9)**. The failure is the `bind` docblock row.
   - Restored: blob equals HEAD `b55fd9e624f4`.

Direction was red both times, as expected. On the resolution path: the root vitest alias maps `@object-ui/sdui-parser` to `packages/sdui-parser/src`, so each mutation reached the subject without a build.

## For objectui#11009 (`domain:skills`): what the `protocol.md` sentence must say

`skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`'s "**Readers only.**" paragraph ends "…renders its header over an empty body — no error, no warning." After this change, the true sentence names the console warning only, and says the parser tier does not flag the key. For example:

> `data-table` does NOT: it reads its rows from an inline `data` array on the node, so a `bind` on it is ignored and the table renders its header over an empty body. Nothing on the page says why; the one signal is a render-time console warning (`[ObjectUI] DataTable bind:`). The parser tier does not flag it either: `bind` is a base prop there, legal on every node.

`skills/**` is not touched here.

## Acceptance notes

- **The `metric-card` in `widgets` candidate row** (review `5878173500`) is not taken. `validateTree`'s traversal is untouched (seat decision). It remains a note for whoever next touches that traversal.
- **The same family, measured but not fixed here** (outside the dispatch's two named keys):
  - `visibleWhen`, `hiddenOn` and `testId` draw `unknown-prop` on all 488 types and are declared by none. `SchemaRenderer`'s hide chain reads `visibleWhen` / `hiddenOn` for every node, and it strips and re-emits `testId`. The mechanical fix would be the same.
  - The canonical ADR-0089 `visibleWhen` warns, while the deprecated `visibleOn`, which is in `BASE_PROPS`, stays silent.
  - `name`, `label`, `description`, `data` and `ariaLabel`, like `placeholder`, are declared as typed inputs by some registrations. For those, joining `BASE_PROPS` trades away type checks, which is a decision rather than a mechanical fix.
  - These go to the seat as one family, for a closure card.
- **The parser's JSX type surface still refuses both keys.** `SduiBaseProps` in `packages/sdui-parser/src/codegen.ts` (written into `sdui-intrinsics.d.ts` by `scripts/gen-manifest.ts`) is a second hand-kept base-prop list. Measured: with the generated types, `tsc` refuses `bind` and `hidden` on `list` with TS2322, while a declared `title` compiles. Not touched here (file surface); reported.
- **objectstack's save-gate copy of `validate.ts` keeps the pre-change `BASE_PROPS`.** `validateJsxPages` runs it when a manifest is resolved. `check-sdui-lockstep.mjs` compares the code set, the parse grammar region and the containment predicate, so it cannot see this split. A port to that copy is owed; reported.
- **A pending changeset now describes superseded wording.** `.changeset/10981-silence-clause-parser-tier-closure.md` describes the intermediate `bind` docblock wording (the parser half). Both entries release together. This PR's changeset names the supersession, and the objectui#10981 body is not edited here.
